newsitem.title: TAIWAN: Taiwan interbank rate ends lower on NCD maturation.
newsitem.headline: Taiwan interbank rate ends lower on NCD maturation.

text.p: Taiwan's interbank rate closed lower on Wednesday following the maturation of T$10 billion in negotiable certificates of deposit issued by the central bank, dealers said.

The overnight interbank rate ended at 4.683 percent against Tuesday's 4.753 close, with 30-day commercial paper at 4.75 against 4.70-4.75. Dealers expected the rates to stabilise with rising liquidity demand ahead of Friday's Mid-Autumn festival.
The bond market saw no transaction in afternoon trade. The 10-year 84/1 bond yield was at 5.6700-5.6725 against 5.7000 after the morning session. -- Julie Hu (5080815)
